tacc_accumulate.status: ADDED as SDC v28 (2026-08-27), signoff-SDC-only. Extends paced_dsp endpoint coverage to the training_acc Zpair_i*/Zpair_q*/Zdiag_* accumulators, whose Q nets surface post-synthesis under trouper_top's top-level `Zpair_q[3][10]` array names (trouper_top.v:329-332) and so are never matched by paced_dsp's `-through u_tacc.*` wildcard. tacc_accumulate.found_via: Post-DRV-closure worst-path analysis on job 5105 (config_1650x1100_full_rect.json + t4b DRV settings): 732/1000 reported SS setup paths violate; ~470 of them are the training_acc Zpair accumulate recurrence, dominated by the WNS path Zpair_q[3][10] -> _62874_.
tacc_accumulate.proof: Same relaxation class as paced_dsp -- the TDM_WAIT=2 pacing (one accumulate per 3 clocks, 16 steps per 64-clock iq_valid sample; training_acc.v:40,89-97) is substantiated by cocotb/tests/test_mcp_tacc_settle.py (settle-gating + reset-mid-burst re-arm) -- SGE job 4083, 8/8 PASS, 2026-08-09. The monitor now directly observes every Zpair_i*/Zpair_q*/Zdiag_* endpoint rather than relying on a transitive argument: a changed endpoint is accepted only on an `acc_active && active_cycle` edge (with the preceding `tdm_wait==TDM_WAIT`) or on the explicit arm-time zero load; both normal and reset-mid-burst re-arm cases pass 2/2 under Verilator on SGE job 5646 (2026-09-05). This directly covers the 512 bare `-to` endpoints. Every write to Zpair_i*/Zpair_q*/Zdiag_* is one of those two cases (training_acc.v:250-256,298), so no fast operand is relaxed. The current job-5630 route audit independently confirms the resolved endpoint collection is non-vacuous.

pcfsm_tick_decrement.sdc_scope: SIGNOFF ONLY -- lives in pnr_32m_scoped_v25_b6_signoff.sdc (SIGNOFF_SDC_FILE), NOT in the P&R SDC. Same rationale as tacc_accumulate / iq_samp_cnt. run_mcp_audit.sh must point MCP_AUDIT_SDC at the _signoff.sdc for this group. Endpoint collection is $pcfsm_timeout_regs, shared with pcfsm_quasi_static / pcfsm_latched_timing_ref / pcfsm_mval (this group is the bare `-to`, no -through, that catches the two arcs those -through blocks miss).
pcfsm_tick_decrement.status: ADDED as SDC v30 (2026-08-27), signoff-SDC-only. Relaxes the two write arcs into packet_ctrl_fsm's B6 per-sample down-counters acq_cnt/wpend_cnt/pkt_cnt that the v21/v24 -through exceptions leave at MCP=1: (A) the sample_count operand of the ST_ACQ_SETUP load (elapsed_c = sample_count[19:0] - lat_timing_ref[19:0], packet_ctrl_fsm.v:114-117,223-225), and (B) the per-tick decrement recurrence `if (iq_tick) cnt <= cnt - 1` (packet_ctrl_fsm.v:166-170). The v25_b6 header left both at MCP=1 only because no -through matched them and there was then no proof iq_tick is sparse.
pcfsm_tick_decrement.found_via: job 5121 (v28+v29 signoff P&R): once tacc_accumulate + iq_samp_cnt were relaxed, the SS setup worst path and its ~130-bit cluster were entirely u_pcfsm.pkt_cnt[*]/wpend_cnt[*]/acq_cnt[*] (`_63606_/dcr_valid` -> ... -> `u_pcfsm.pkt_cnt[10]` = `_63751_`, WNS -15.51 ns). iq_samp_cnt (v29) itself was not in the violating set.
pcfsm_tick_decrement.proof: Arc B (decrement recurrence): iq_tick == dcr_valid is a 1-clock pulse with measured >=64-cycle spacing -- cocotb/tests/test_mcp_iq_samp_cnt_settle.py::test_dcr_valid_single_cycle, SGE job 5120, 3/3 PASS -- so the recurrence has ~63 idle IQ_CLK cycles between launches (21x the 3-cycle budget) and never a back-to-back launch (hold-2 reference edge carries identical data). Arc A (sample_count -> load): the ST_ACQ_SETUP dwell (setup_cnt 0->3, capture at setup_cnt==3, packet_ctrl_fsm.v:205-227) was added specifically to give the load cone 3 settled edges (Open Risks #43), proven by cocotb/tests/test_mcp_pcfsm_settle.py (4-cycle dwell, capture at u+4, adversarial config write before/at lock edge) -- SGE job 4362, 4/4; the `- iq_tick` term in acq_rem_w/wpend_rem_w/pkt_rem_w (packet_ctrl_fsm.v:115-117) corrects for a tick landing inside the dwell, so MCP=3 across the whole load arc (sample_count included) matches the same RTL intent pcfsm_latched_timing_ref / pcfsm_mval already rely on. The only writes to these regs are the load, the decrement, and the async reset (packet_ctrl_fsm.v:135-137), so the bare `-to` scope is honest (v18 bshift_regs / v28 tacc_acc_regs precedent). A dedicated cocotb assertion that iq_samp_cnt-driven decrement operands are stable >=3 cycles before every armed-state iq_tick would close arc A's sample_count leg fully (test_mcp_iq_samp_cnt_settle.py covers the dcr_valid spacing but at trouper_top level, not the pcfsm decrement path specifically). Non-vacuity to be confirmed by run_mcp_audit.sh --stage route against the _signoff.sdc on the next clean routed netlist.
pcfsm_tick_decrement._comment_note: min_through 0 / min_endpoint 1: bare -to, endpoint set = $pcfsm_timeout_regs (acq_cnt/wpend_cnt/pkt_cnt dff cells), expected ~62 endpoint objects.

iq_samp_cnt.sdc_scope: SIGNOFF ONLY -- lives in pnr_32m_scoped_v25_b6_signoff.sdc (SIGNOFF_SDC_FILE), NOT in the P&R SDC. Same rationale as tacc_accumulate: keeping paced MCPs out of the P&R SDC leaves the placed/routed netlist bit-identical to job 5105 and avoids the resizer perturbation that stranded the IQ_CLK root clkbuf (DRT-0073, job 5112). run_mcp_audit.sh must point MCP_AUDIT_SDC at the _signoff.sdc for this group. NOTE (job 5121): the SS worst-path dcr_valid cluster is actually u_pcfsm.{pkt,wpend,acq}_cnt (see pcfsm_tick_decrement group) -- iq_samp_cnt's own paths were not in the violating set, so this group is correct but had no measured WNS/TNS effect; kept for completeness and audited for non-vacuity.
iq_samp_cnt.status: ADDED as SDC v29 (2026-08-27), signoff-SDC-only. Scopes the top-level 32-bit sample counter iq_samp_cnt[*] (trouper_top.v:171, `if (dcr_valid) iq_samp_cnt <= iq_samp_cnt + 32'd1`). Not a u_dec.* net, so paced_dsp's -through wildcard never covered it.
iq_samp_cnt.found_via: job 5118 (v28 signoff-only P&R): once tacc_accumulate relaxed the training_acc cone, the SS setup worst path became `_63606_/dcr_valid` -> xor2/oai/... -> `_63751_` (an iq_samp_cnt bit), WNS -15.51 ns, ~130 sibling violators.
iq_samp_cnt.proof: cocotb/tests/test_mcp_iq_samp_cnt_settle.py (top-level trouper_top), SGE job 5120, 3/3 PASS: (1) test_dcr_valid_single_cycle -- dcr_valid never high on two consecutive IQ_CLK edges (~40 pulses, measured min spacing 64 cycles); structurally sd_decimator_poly.v:348 sets iq_valid<=4'hf on hb2_stream_last only (zeroed every other cycle) and dc_removal.v:110 is a 1-cycle registered passthrough. (2) test_iq_samp_cnt_settle_gating -- 51 increments, every one +1 and every one on a post-dcr_valid edge, min gap 64 IQ_CLK cycles (21x the 3-cycle setup budget). (3) test_reset_mid_stream_rearm -- clears to 0 on reset between pulses and on a reset coincident with a dcr_valid delta, then re-arms and resumes under the same discipline. With no adjacent launch edge the 2-hold reference edge carries identical data, so hold is safe. The only writes to iq_samp_cnt are the async reset and the +1, so the bare `-to` endpoint scope is honest (v18 bshift_regs / v28 tacc_acc_regs precedent). Non-vacuity to be confirmed by run_mcp_audit.sh --stage route against the _signoff.sdc on the next clean routed netlist.
